composition_limits: Reference wide shots deliberately retain the source framing, so the car is small relative to the ramp.
At9.5s the car approaches the top frame edge and is partially clipped in the supplied reference render; this edit does not crop or repair that source framing.
Inspection720p is upscaled uniformly to1080p in the social video.
Gas and vehicle motion remain an authored reconstruction draft; this media pass is not physical validation.
time_and_framing_limits: The inspection segment repeats part of the same physical action; it is not another event or continuous extension of the reference sequence.
The GIF uses 12 fps frame selection and palette quantization for display; it is not suitable for exact source-frame or event-timing measurement.
Full reference framing is retained, including small vehicle scale in wide shots and the existing partial top-edge clipping.

findings: Cover uses a clear rear close view and visible ramp context.

acceptance_statement: Decode, dimensions, timing and sampled presentation checks do not establish a new reconstruction-fidelity or vehicle-physics result. Existing silhouette/center metrics and limitations remain unchanged; the project remains an editable reconstruction draft.
